title: ID0453699-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP/R6 170002059] EVSE is not ready due to QA9-10 fault
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
PLC-Error-Flag 'DC_Contactor_MG1-MG2_QA9-10' initial value true - (contactor stuck at ON feedback)
Solution: Replace QA9-10

additional_info.subject: SONOL EILAT - Serial number 17000205- when CP2 is taken CP1 isn't available
additional_info.body:
Hi,
We have a problem with ChargePoint 17000205- 160 KW
charger in Eilat , Israel.
We saw today 5/10/25 a few times problem :
evse is not ready
It seems to happen when a vehicle is charging in ChargePoint 2 and another vehicle is trying to charge on ChargePoint 1.
Please check it out ASAP
Thanks,
Leeron Fridman,
Sonol EVI
leeron@sonolevi.co.il
972-55-3069946
